name: Metro apartment project · Partnership terms decision (real project, anonymised)
decision_question: Under the clause “the owner contributes 3 million yuan for the fit-out / the operator contributes a 1 million yuan performance deposit / 65:35 revenue share”, should we take on the brand operation of this apartment project?
goals: Verify whether the partnership terms hold up on unit economics
Determine the acceptable rent range and revenue-share structure
Identify, before signing, the compliance risks that would close the statutory channel
constraints: The owner requires the 3 million yuan fit-out investment to pay back within 48 months
The rent must be lower than the market rent for comparable quality in the same location (hard compliance constraint)
The property title's designated use is industrial (non-residential premises); the conversion of non-residential existing housing into subsidised rental housing is the only statutory channel
The operator pays a 1 million yuan performance deposit, used solely to guarantee performance
known_facts: Total floor area of 2,751.34 square metres; there is no dispute over the title
After conversion, 75 rooms can be laid out, averaging about 25.68 square metres of floor area per room
The official reference rent for long-term rental apartments (this subdistrict) is 90 yuan per square metre per month
Existing competing products on the same street average 29.82 square metres of floor area per unit
About a 9-minute walk to the nearest metro station, a two-line interchange
assumptions: Steady-state occupancy can reach 93%, and 88% within 6 months of opening
Blended rent of 89.7 yuan per square metre per month, and an average price of 2,182 yuan per room
Monthly operating overheads of 15,000 yuan (200 yuan per room per month)
A one-off marketing budget of 400,000 yuan for the opening period
unknowns: Whether the land parcel is Class III industrial land (if it is, the statutory channel closes)
Whether it lies within an industrial block (if it does, the statutory channel closes)
Whether the owner or the operator bears the 400,000 yuan opening marketing cost
The full line-item breakdown of the operator's actual operating costs (the document gives only a total, with no split)
The actual customer segment mix from the pre-registration questionnaire, n≥100

decision_records.question: Under the clause “the owner contributes 3 million yuan for the fit-out / the operator contributes a 1 million yuan performance deposit / 65:35 revenue share”, should we take on the brand operation of this apartment project?
decision_records.chosen_option: Run a clause stress test first, renegotiate the revenue-share structure, then sign
